component.name: RustWeather
component.summary: The temperature in your tray and a weather radar

description.p: RustWeather shows the temperature in the system tray, in a color that matches it, and says when rain is coming. A click opens the weather; a radar that loads at once shows where the rain goes.

ul.li: Radar from the DWD and RainViewer with free zoom, smooth motion and a two-hour forecast
Rain arrival at your place, warnings, lightning and wind as layers
Forecast, air quality and pollen, for several places
Keeps working offline with the last data and a map of its own
